Good day and welcome! 😊 Our Special Needs School at 18 Elweboog, Meerensee sounds like it could be a wonderful fit for your little girl. We offer individualised care with small, focused class groups, a dedicated team of specialists who create personalised learning programmes, and therapy support — all in a nurturing, inclusive environment.

Enrolment is open, and I'd recommend visiting the school to see our facilities and chat with the team about your daughter's specific needs. You can reach the office at **info@tingalingschools.com**, **0615274429 / 0724561282** during office hours (07:00–15:30 weekdays) to arrange a tour.
